author: avibang
body: The view distance is helpful to find dungeons/etc. on the map which you can save separate gear loadouts for in order to do damage while in them. So I’d suggest to just have your overworld loadout with the highest VD possible using the Surtr sword with socketed VD gems and offhand one of the Firepikes to best maximize the stat
